LanguageData.RaidersInherit.InheritanceChance.Label: Chance to enable inheritance: {0}
LanguageData.RaidersInherit.InheritanceChance.Tooltip: This percentage is rolled once for each generated enemy raid. A successful roll allows Raiders Inherit to take over if that raid defeats your last viable colonist, replacing the vanilla Man in Black rescue with the settings below. An unsuccessful roll leaves that raid alone, so the vanilla rescue remains available if its own normal conditions are met.
LanguageData.RaidersInherit.InheritEntireRaid.Label: Inherit entire remaining raid
LanguageData.RaidersInherit.InheritEntireRaid.Tooltip: If enabled, every living raider still on the map joins your colony, instead of only the number set below. No raiders are released as allies in this mode.
LanguageData.RaidersInherit.RaidersToInherit.Label: Raiders to inherit
LanguageData.RaidersInherit.RaidersToInherit.Tooltip: This many randomly chosen surviving raiders join your colony. The rest are released as non-hostile allies and leave the map peacefully. If the raid has fewer survivors than this, all of them join.
LanguageData.RaidersInherit.JoinedLetterText: With your colony defeated, {0} raiders from {1} have decided to take over the colony: {2}.\n\nThe remaining {3} raiders have been released as non-hostile wanderers and are leaving the area. They will not attack the colony's new inhabitants.
LanguageData.RaidersInherit.JoinedLetterTextAllJoined: With your colony defeated, the entire attacking raid from {1} has decided to take over the colony: {2}.\n\nNone of the attackers remain hostile.
